synopsis: FalconCloud is the web-accessed cloud component of Duality AI Falcon, a commercial digital-twin simulator built on Unreal Engine; Unreal and FalconCloud are also listed as its interfaces [f8418, f8980]. The tools chapter and glossary identify FalconCloud as a vendor-cloud execution offering, with the glossary explaining that vendor clouds run a specific simulator [f8368, f8662, f16059]. Its off-road relevance follows the underlying platform rather than being independently established for the cloud offering [f9255]. Public prices were not found for FalconCloud or the other listed vendor-cloud options, and the pricing table cites sources dated 2024–2026 [f9256, f16060]. FalconCloud was the latest release entry found for Duality AI Falcon, but no release date was found [f8982].
